evidence: Modifies PSBT creation defaults in src/psbt.h, feebumper.cpp, and wallet-facing GUI dialogs in src/qt/walletmodel.cpp and sendcoinsdialog.cpp.
rationale: Fixes interoperability failures where GUI users exporting PSBTs encountered errors with hardware wallets and external signers lacking BIP-370 (PSBTv2) support. Defaulting to PSBTv0 resolves widespread hardware wallet incompatibility for exported transactions.
